name: Noapara Metro (Park & Ride)
note: Leave the car here and ride the Blue Line to Shyambazar or Sovabazar.

name: Dum Dum Metro Area (Park & Ride)
note: Ride the metro south, or take an auto to Dum Dum Park.

name: Hatibagan Pay & Park (Bidhan Sarani)
note: Usually closed after 4 pm on the main puja days. Check the KP advisory.

name: Sealdah Station Parking
note: The best car base for Santosh Mitra and Sealdah RAC.

name: New Market Multi-level Parking
note: Walk or take the metro north from Esplanade.

name: Lake Mall (Rashbehari)
note: Right in the Tridhara–Deshapriya–66 Pally cluster. Fills by 6 pm.

name: Forum Mall (Elgin Road)
note: A good base for Maddox Square and Bhowanipore.

name: Quest Mall (Ballygunge Circular Rd)
note: Take a cab or the metro south to the Gariahat cluster.

name: South City Mall
note: The base for Jodhpur Park and Babubagan. A cab to Ekdalia takes about 10 minutes.

name: Behala Bazar Metro (Purple Line)
note: Close to Behala Notun Dal and Sahajatri.

name: New Alipore Police-marked Street Parking
note: Follow the cones. Suruchi Sangha is a 5-minute walk.

name: City Centre 1 Parking
note: Walk to FD Block, or take a short auto to BJ Block.

name: Central Park Salt Lake (Puja Lot)
note: A temporary lot that usually opens on the puja days.

name: Diamond Plaza (Jessore Road)
note: Leave the car here. VIP Road near Sreebhumi stays jammed for hours.

name: Howrah Station Parking
note: Paid parking at the station forecourt; from here the Green Line, buses and totos fan out across Howrah. Ask at the counter for overnight rates.

name: Avani Riverside Mall (Shibpur)
note: The handiest mall car park for the Shibpur pujas. Check closing time before you leave the car late.
